title: Neuroscience and psychology should co-evolve, not stay autonomous

statements.text: Against the functionalist ideology that cognitive psychology is autonomous of neuroscience, the two should develop together: mental states are brain states, the human nervous system evolved from simpler ones, brains are by far the best information processors to study, it is perverse to ignore what neuroscience finds about memory and learning, and the categories at any level may need revision from research at any level.

sources.quote: Five general reasons speak against the autonomy ideology and in favor of embracing an ideology of co-evolutionary development
Categories at any level specifying the fundamental kinds may need to be revised, and the revisionary rationales may come from research at any level
